mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate duloxetine's SIADH effects and increase risk of hyponatremia; duloxetine may inhibit platelet aggregation increasing bleeding risk in volume-depleted states.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (sodium, potassium) regularly; assess for hyponatremia symptoms; ensure adequate hydration; consider potassium supplementation if needed; monitor for bleeding signs.
